label: 86 Chaos 17.0.27
notes: Moves Schedule Builder shift assignment from a fragile direct browser Firestore write to an authenticated, tenant-bound server assignment operation while preserving existing Schedule Builder authority.
Makes one assignment request atomic across the selected dates, idempotent for accidental request replay, and returns the exact created shift identities so the builder updates immediately.
Clears stale local deletion tombstones when a shift is re-added after Clear Month or single-shift deletion, preventing a valid new assignment from being hidden by prior delete UI state.

Adds visible Assignment Failed feedback plus new Node and deployed Playwright release-gate coverage for assigning and cleaning up a QA shift. Phase 1 Spanish and the repaired delta workflow are preserved.
